hub.heroSubtitle: Private guided adventures from 5 to 12 days on a Royal Enfield Himalayan 450. Mountains, coffee country, Pacific beaches and the Caribbean.
hub.introTitle: Guided motorcycle tours Panama, designed by riders who live here
hub.introBody: Panama is one of the best motorcycle destinations in Central America: smooth mountain roads, empty coastal highways, rainforest, volcanic highlands and two oceans within a day’s ride. Our guided motorcycle tours take care of everything: the bike, the route, the hotels, the fuel and the meals, with a private guide riding with you from Panama City to the final day. Choose a ready-made itinerary below, or ask us to adapt one to your dates and pace.

hub.faqTitle: Motorcycle tours in Panama: your questions

faq.q: What is included in a guided motorcycle tour in Panama?
faq.a: A private guide, a Royal Enfield Himalayan 450 with helmet, fuel throughout the trip, accommodation, full board, a private tailored itinerary and assistance during the whole journey. Flights, travel insurance and personal expenses are not included.

faq.q: Which motorcycle do you use for the tours?
faq.a: All tours are ridden on the Royal Enfield Himalayan 450, a light and capable adventure bike that handles both paved mountain roads and rougher tracks.

faq.q: How many days should I plan for a motorcycle tour in Panama?
faq.a: Five days is enough for the central mountains and the Pacific coast. Seven days adds the Emberá community and Santa Fe. With 10 days you reach Boca Chica and Boquete, and 12 days take you all the way to Bocas del Toro on the Caribbean.

faq.q: Can I do a motorcycle tour to Boquete or Bocas del Toro?
faq.a: Yes. Boquete is part of our 10-day Panama Grand Loop and our 12-day Panama Across the Wild, which also finishes in the islands of Bocas del Toro.

faq.q: How do I book a tour?
faq.a: Send us a message on WhatsApp with the tour you like and your dates. We confirm availability, hotel category and price, then you secure your dates.

faq.q: Do I need a motorcycle licence?
faq.a: Yes, you need a valid motorcycle licence to ride. Contact us on WhatsApp if you have any doubt about your documents.

detail.ctaBody: Send us a WhatsApp message with your dates and group size. We reply with availability and a personalised quote.

central.name: Ruta Central & Pacífico
central.tagline: 5 days · 4 nights · Valle de Antón, Santa Catalina, Cambutal, Las Tablas
central.metaTitle: 5-Day Panama Motorcycle Tour | Valle de Antón, Santa Catalina & Las Tablas
central.metaDescription: Guided 5-day motorcycle tour in Panama: Valle de Antón, Santa Catalina, Cambutal and Las Tablas on a Royal Enfield Himalayan 450. Guide, fuel and hotels included. Book on WhatsApp.
central.keywords: 5 day motorcycle tour Panama, Valle de Anton motorcycle tour, Santa Catalina motorcycle tour, Azuero motorcycle tour, Cambutal motorcycle, Las Tablas motorcycle tour, short motorcycle tour Panama
central.route: Panama City · Valle de Antón · Santa Catalina · Cambutal · Las Tablas · Panama City
central.intro: The perfect first taste of Panama on two wheels. In five days you ride from Panama City into the volcanic highlands of Valle de Antón, down to the surf town of Santa Catalina, along the wild beaches of Cambutal and through the traditional villages of Azuero before returning to the capital. A private guide, the bike and the hotels are all taken care of.
highlights: Valle de Antón and its mountain roads
Cambutal: pristine beaches and sea turtles
Authentic Azuero towns around Las Tablas

days.title: Panama City → Valle de Antón
days.body: Meet us at Overland Motorcycles at 8 AM for the motorcycle and helmet handover and the route briefing. Ride to Valle de Antón (131 km), a green crater valley surrounded by mountains. Overnight in Valle de Antón.

days.title: Valle de Antón → Santa Catalina
days.body: Head to the Pacific coast and the surf town of Santa Catalina on a coastal route heading south. Overnight in Santa Catalina.

days.title: Santa Catalina → Cambutal
days.body: Continue south along the coast to Cambutal: pristine beaches, sea turtles and untouched nature. Overnight in Cambutal.

days.title: Cambutal → Las Tablas
days.body: A coastal ride of about 84 km to Las Tablas. Experience the authentic spirit of Panama through colourful towns, rolling countryside and traditional landscapes. Overnight in Las Tablas.

days.title: Las Tablas → Panama City
days.body: Return via the Inter-American Highway (about 281 km). Hand over the motorcycles at Overland Motorcycles, then transfer to your hotel or the airport.

faq.q: Is the 5-day tour a good first motorcycle tour in Panama?
faq.a: Yes. It combines mountains, Pacific coast and traditional villages at a steady pace, with a private guide handling the route and logistics.

faq.q: How many nights are included in the 5-day tour?
faq.a: Four nights: Valle de Antón, Santa Catalina, Cambutal and Las Tablas.

faq.q: Does the tour start and end in Panama City?
faq.a: Yes. The pick-up is at Overland Motorcycles in Panama City at 8 AM on day 1 and you return the bikes there on day 5, with a transfer to your hotel or the airport.

grand.name: The Grand Panama Adventure
grand.tagline: 7 days · 6 nights · Gamboa, Emberá, Valle de Antón, Santa Catalina, Santa Fe, Coronado
grand.metaTitle: 7-Day Panama Motorcycle Tour | Emberá, Santa Catalina & Santa Fe
grand.metaDescription: Guided 7-day motorcycle tour in Panama: Gamboa, Emberá community, Valle de Antón, Santa Catalina, Santa Fe and Coronado. Royal Enfield Himalayan 450, guide and hotels included.
grand.keywords: 7 day motorcycle tour Panama, Embera motorcycle tour, Santa Fe Veraguas motorcycle tour, Coiba motorcycle tour, Santa Catalina motorcycle tour, Panama canal motorcycle tour, Gamboa motorcycle
grand.route: Gamboa · Emberá · Valle de Antón · Santa Catalina · Santa Fe · Coronado · Panama City
grand.intro: From the waterways of the Panama Canal to the rainforest, from indigenous communities to the Pacific Ocean and the mountains of Veraguas: this is Panama experienced at its most authentic. A week of riding with a private guide, with a visit to an Emberá community, the option of a Coiba National Park excursion and a rest day in the cool mountain village of Santa Fe.
highlights: Gamboa, Chagres River and the Panama Canal rainforest
Emberá community: canoe ride, crafts, music and local lunch
Santa Catalina and optional Coiba National Park (UNESCO)
Santa Fe: waterfalls, mountain coffee and Ngäbe artisans

days.title: Panama City → Gamboa → Valle de Antón
days.body: Motorcycle and helmet pick-up at Overland Motorcycles at 8 AM. First ride to Gamboa (about 30 km): the Panama Canal, rainforest reserve and Chagres River. Emberá experience: canoe ride, community visit, traditional crafts, music and a local lunch. Afternoon ride to Valle de Antón (about 180 km). Overnight in Valle de Antón.

days.title: Valle de Antón → Santa Catalina
days.body: A relaxed morning in Valle de Antón: mountain roads, local trails and waterfalls. In the afternoon, ride to the Pacific coast (about 250 km). Overnight in Santa Catalina.

days.title: Santa Catalina: Coiba & the sea
days.body: Optional excursion to Coiba National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, for snorkelling, diving and exceptional marine wildlife. Relaxed afternoon on the beach and sunset over the Pacific. Overnight in Santa Catalina.

days.title: Santa Catalina → Santa Fe
days.body: Ride inland from the coast into the mountains of Veraguas (about 169 km). Discover the El Bermejo waterfalls, high-altitude coffee, orchids and Ngäbe artisans. Overnight in Santa Fe.

days.title: Free day in Santa Fe
days.body: Hike to hidden waterfalls, swim in natural pools and explore the Ngäbe-Buglé artisan market. Optional visits to local coffee and cacao farms. Second night in Santa Fe.

days.title: Santa Fe → Coronado
days.body: Continue east along the Pacific side of Panama through small towns, rural landscapes and coastal roads to Coronado, one of the country’s most established beach communities. Overnight in Coronado.

days.title: Coronado → Panama City
days.body: Follow the Pan-American Highway back to the capital (about 90 km) and hand over the motorcycles at Overland Motorcycles.

faq.q: Does the 7-day tour include the Emberá community visit?
faq.a: Yes, day 1 includes a canoe ride on the river, a visit to an Emberá community, traditional crafts, music and a local lunch.

faq.q: Can I visit Coiba National Park on this tour?
faq.a: Coiba is an optional excursion on day 3 from Santa Catalina, with snorkelling and diving in a UNESCO World Heritage marine park. Tell us on WhatsApp if you want it included.

faq.q: How many nights are included in the 7-day tour?
faq.a: Six nights: Valle de Antón, Santa Catalina (2 nights), Santa Fe (2 nights) and Coronado.

loop.name: The Panama Grand Loop
loop.tagline: 10 days · 9 nights · Valle de Antón, Santa Fe, Boca Chica, Boquete, Santa Catalina, Coronado
loop.metaTitle: 10-Day Panama Motorcycle Tour | Boquete, Boca Chica & Santa Catalina
loop.metaDescription: Guided 10-day motorcycle tour in Panama: Valle de Antón, Santa Fe, Boca Chica, Boquete, Santa Catalina and Coiba. Royal Enfield Himalayan 450, guide, fuel and hotels included.
loop.keywords: 10 day motorcycle tour Panama, Boquete motorcycle tour, Boca Chica motorcycle tour, Chiriqui motorcycle tour, Panama coffee motorcycle tour, tour moto Boquete, Panama grand loop motorcycle
loop.route: Valle de Antón · Santa Fe · Boca Chica · Boquete · Santa Catalina · Coronado · Panama City
loop.intro: A full loop of Panama’s mountains, coffee country, tropical forests and Pacific coastline on a private guided adventure, designed to experience the country beyond the usual routes. Ten days take you from Valle de Antón to the Boca Chica archipelago, the coffee highlands of Boquete and the surf town of Santa Catalina, with the option of a Coiba Island day.
highlights: Santa Fe: El Bermejo waterfalls and mountain coffee
Boca Chica and its island archipelago
Boquete: coffee, volcanic mountains and waterfalls
Santa Catalina and Coiba National Park

days.title: Panama City → Valle de Antón
days.body: Motorcycle and helmet handover at Overland Motorcycles at 8 AM and route briefing. Ride to Valle de Antón (about 128 km): volcanic landscapes, waterfalls, lush trails, local markets and mountain scenery. Overnight in Valle de Antón.

days.title: Valle de Antón → Santa Fe
days.body: Ride deeper into the mountains of Veraguas (about 191 km). Discover the El Bermejo waterfalls, high-altitude coffee farms, orchids and Ngäbe artisans. Overnight in Santa Fe.

days.title: Santa Fe → Boca Chica
days.body: Ride towards the Pacific coast of Chiriquí (about 225 km). Boca Chica is a laid-back fishing village with pristine beaches, lush nature and endless opportunities for adventure. Overnight in Boca Chica.

days.title: Boca Chica archipelago
days.body: A day on white sand beaches, swimming in clear waters and discovering hidden island gems. Overnight in Boca Chica.

days.title: Boca Chica → Boquete
days.body: Ride through Panama’s coffee-growing region (about 104 km). Boquete: lush mountains, world-renowned coffee and waterfalls. Overnight in Boquete.

days.title: Boquete
days.body: A scenic ride through volcanic mountains and world-famous coffee country. Fresh mountain air, spectacular landscapes and authentic Panamanian culture. Overnight in Boquete.

days.title: Boquete → Santa Catalina
days.body: Head back to the Pacific coast and the laid-back surf town of Santa Catalina, surrounded by beaches and nature. Overnight in Santa Catalina.

days.title: Santa Catalina: Coiba Island
days.body: A day dedicated to the gateway of Coiba National Park: turquoise water, abundant marine life and some of Panama’s most pristine beaches. Overnight in Santa Catalina.

days.title: Santa Catalina → Coronado
days.body: Ride along the Pacific coast, with winding roads, ocean views and the freedom of the open road, to the coastal escape of Coronado. Overnight in Coronado.

days.title: Coronado → Panama City
days.body: The final leg follows scenic coastal roads through authentic Panamanian villages and lush tropical landscapes back to Panama City, where you return the motorcycles.

faq.q: Does the 10-day motorcycle tour go to Boquete?
faq.a: Yes. Days 5 and 6 are in Boquete, with a ride through the coffee highlands, volcanic mountains and waterfalls.
Yes, two nights in Boca Chica with a full free day to explore the island archipelago.

faq.q: How many nights are included in the 10-day tour?
faq.a: Nine nights: Valle de Antón, Santa Fe, Boca Chica (2), Boquete (2), Santa Catalina (2) and Coronado.

wild.name: Panama Across the Wild
wild.tagline: 12 days · 11 nights · From the Pacific to Bocas del Toro on the Caribbean
wild.metaTitle: 12-Day Panama Motorcycle Tour | Pacific to Bocas del Toro Caribbean
wild.metaDescription: Guided 12-day motorcycle tour across Panama from the Pacific coast to Bocas del Toro: Valle de Antón, Santa Fe, Santa Catalina, Boca Chica and Boquete. Guide, fuel and hotels included.
wild.keywords: 12 day motorcycle tour Panama, Bocas del Toro motorcycle tour, tour moto Bocas del Toro, Panama coast to coast motorcycle, Panama Pacific to Caribbean motorcycle, Boquete Bocas motorcycle tour, long motorcycle tour Panama
wild.route: Panama City · Valle de Antón · Santa Fe · Santa Catalina · Boca Chica · Boquete · Bocas del Toro
wild.intro: Our longest and most complete motorcycle tour: twelve days across Panama from the Pacific coast to the Caribbean. Ride mountain roads, coffee country, tropical forests and remote coastal landscapes before finishing in the islands of Bocas del Toro, with a free day to explore the archipelago by boat.
highlights: Valle de Antón with a full day in the mountains
Santa Fe waterfalls and Coiba National Park
Boca Chica archipelago and Boquete coffee country
Finish in Bocas del Toro, on the Caribbean

days.title: Panama City → Valle de Antón
days.body: Motorcycle and helmet handover at Overland Motorcycles at 8 AM and route briefing. Ride to Valle de Antón (about 128 km): volcanic landscapes, waterfalls, lush trails and local markets. Overnight in Valle de Antón.

days.title: Valle de Antón
days.body: A full day in the valley: mountains, waterfalls, nature and wildlife. Overnight in Valle de Antón.

days.title: Valle de Antón → Santa Fe
days.body: Ride deeper into the mountains of Veraguas (about 191 km). Discover the El Bermejo waterfalls, high-altitude coffee farms, orchids and Ngäbe artisans. Overnight in Santa Fe.

days.title: Santa Fe → Santa Catalina
days.body: Ride down to the Pacific coast. Overnight in Santa Catalina.

days.title: Santa Catalina: Coiba Island
days.body: The gateway to Coiba National Park: turquoise water, abundant marine life and some of Panama’s most pristine beaches. Overnight in Santa Catalina.

days.title: Santa Catalina → Boca Chica
days.body: Ride towards Boca Chica (about 225 km), a laid-back fishing village on the Pacific coast with pristine beaches and lush nature. Overnight in Boca Chica.

days.title: Boca Chica archipelago
days.body: A day on white sand beaches, swimming in clear waters and discovering hidden island gems. Overnight in Boca Chica.

days.title: Boca Chica → Boquete
days.body: Ride through Panama’s coffee-growing region (about 104 km). Boquete: lush mountains, world-renowned coffee and waterfalls. Overnight in Boquete.

days.title: Boquete
days.body: A scenic ride through volcanic mountains and world-famous coffee country, with fresh mountain air and spectacular landscapes. Overnight in Boquete.

days.title: Boquete → Bocas del Toro
days.body: The final riding day takes you from the mountains to Panama’s Caribbean coast (about 200 km). Leave the motorcycles securely, then continue by boat to the islands of Bocas del Toro. Overnight in Bocas del Toro.

days.title: Bocas del Toro: free day
days.body: A full day to discover the archipelago: explore the islands by boat, swim in crystal-clear water, visit hidden beaches or enjoy the Caribbean atmosphere. Overnight in Bocas del Toro.

days.title: Bocas del Toro: departure
days.body: A final morning in the Caribbean before your onward journey. End of the Overland Motorcycles adventure.

faq.q: Does this motorcycle tour finish in Bocas del Toro?
faq.a: Yes. The last riding day goes from Boquete to the Caribbean coast, then you continue by boat to the islands of Bocas del Toro for the final two nights.
Yes, two nights in Boquete in the middle of the tour, with a day riding through the coffee highlands.

faq.q: How many nights are included in the 12-day tour?
faq.a: Eleven nights: Valle de Antón (2), Santa Fe, Santa Catalina (2), Boca Chica (2), Boquete (2) and Bocas del Toro (2).
